steps_tex: Products: $0 \times 2=0$, $1 \times 4=4$, $2 \times 6=12$, $3 \times 8=24$, $4 \times 3=12$, $5 \times 5=25$, $6 \times 1=6$, $7 \times 1=7$
Sum $= 90$ wickets
item.answer_tex: $(a)$: Information on the number of wickets taken in different numbers of matches; $(b)$: e.g. Wickets taken by Jaspreet Bumrah in last $30$ matches; $(c)$: in $1$ match he took $7$ wickets (open); $(d)$: $3$; $(e)$: No; $(f)$: add a third column of products, total $= 90$
steps: Matches total 2+4+6+8+3+5+1+1 = 30
Sum = 90 wickets
item.answer: a. Information on the number of wickets taken in different numbers of matches; b. e.g. Wickets taken by Jaspreet Bumrah in last 30 matches; c. in 1 match he took 7 wickets (open); d. 3; e. No; f. add a third column of products, total = 90
item.text:
$1$. Matches total $2+4+6+8+3+5+1+1 = 30$
$2$. Products: $0 \times 2=0$, $1 \times 4=4$, $2 \times 6=12$, $3 \times 8=24$, $4 \times 3=12$, $5 \times 5=25$, $6 \times 1=6$, $7 \times 1=7$
$3$. Sum $= 90$ wickets
Answer: $(a)$: Information on the number of wickets taken in different numbers of matches; $(b)$: e.g. Wickets taken by Jaspreet Bumrah in last $30$ matches; $(c)$: in $1$ match he took $7$ wickets (open); $(d)$: $3$; $(e)$: No; $(f)$: add a third column of products, total $= 90$
